newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle lower in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle lower in thin volume.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed weaker as the market retraced recent gains amid an ongoing negative technical and fundamental outlook, analysts said.
The benchmark September contract closed 1.20 cents lower at 74.50 cents per lb, having ranged from 76.00 to 74.10 cents. The rest of the board finished 0.40 to 1.40 weaker.
An estimated 1,500 lots changed hands on the day compared with Monday's official 1,103 lots.
Traders said the September contract began its slide to the lows after climbing to but failing to pierce resistance at 76.00 cents.
Near-term support in September remained at the contract low of 73.60 cents, followed by 72.00 cents, analysts said.
Prices are expected to drift sideways to lower as the market awaits a private estimate of the 1997/98 crop by Citrus Consulting International.
The widely-watched estimate will be released on August 14.
